gholam.text:
رفیق، پلتفرم bolt.new اومده کل آخر هفته رو برای همه کاربرا کاملاً رایگان کرده تا هر ایده نرم‌افزاری که گوشه ذهنت داری رو بدون معطلی تبدیل به یه محصول واقعی کنی. ماجرا فقط به استفاده مجانی ختم نمیشه و هم‌زمان یه رویداد خفن به اسم «هفته سازندگان بولت» راه انداختن که جایزه نقدی ۱۰ هزار دلاری داره. فقط کافیه تا ۲۰ اکتبر ایده‌ت رو بسازی و پروژه‌ت رو بفرستی تا توی قرعه‌کشی و داوری این جایزه تپل شرکت داده بشی.

اهمیتش اینه که بدون یه ریال هزینه اشتراک می‌تونی دستت رو با قوی‌ترین ابزارهای کدنویسی هوش مصنوعی گرم کنی و شانس بردن یه جایزه دلاری درست‌ودرمون رو داشته باشی.

links.title: Builders Week | Bolt
links.description: Builders Week on Bolt, Oct 17–24: build your business with a free build weekend, a week of live sessions with the Bolt team, and $10,000 to scale what you build.
links.text:
Ask Eric & Albert anything
Bolt’s co-founders take your questions live and unscripted: the turnaround, the riskiest product bets, and the advice they think is overrated. Send your questions in advance.
Eric Simons, CEO, and Albert Pai, CTO
From Saturday Oct 17 at 12:00am PT to Sunday Oct 18 at 11:59pm PT, every Bolt user gets GLM 5.3 Flash free in the model picker. No plan change, no code to redeem.
Free, personal paid and Teams accounts all get it. On Teams, every member gets their own allowance.
Your allowance comes in six-hour blocks. A block starts when you open Bolt, and your first visit after it ends starts the next one.
Paid plans get five times the free allowance in every block.
The free weekend runs from Saturday Oct 17 at 12:00am PT to Sunday Oct 18 at 11:59pm PT. GLM 5.3 Flash is the only free model during the weekend. Rate limits apply. Blocks you miss do not carry over.
Builders Week runs Oct 17 to 24: a free build weekend, a week of sessions, and a contest.
Turn your business idea into a product in Bolt, or grow the one you run. Submissions are open from Oct 13 to Oct 20.
Free building on GLM 5.3 Flash for everyone on Bolt, free and paid, Teams included. Starts Sat Oct 17 at 12:00am PT, ends Sun Oct 18 at 11:59pm PT.
A Q&A with Bolt’s co-founders and live workshops on SEO, growth and design for your business.
Submissions close Oct 20 and judging runs Oct 21 to 31. Winners are announced here and on social.
A founder Q&A and live workshops on SEO, growth and design, all about growing a business on Bolt.
Three SEO tips for your Bolt site: titles that earn the click, getting your pages found, and one search term per page.
Onboarding, adoption and retention: get new users to a first win, keep them coming back, and spot who is about to leave.
A design and branding clinic: what makes customers choose you, then live reviews of founder projects. Share yours in the chat.
Turn a business idea into a product, or grow the business you already run. Build it in Bolt and submit it by Oct 20. Winners are announced on or about Oct 31.
Paid in U.S. dollars, plus a 1:1 mentoring session with Eric Simons, Bolt’s co-founder and CEO.
Paid in U.S. dollars.
Judged on use of Bolt, the idea, implementation and design, and potential impact, weighted equally. No purchase necessary. Open to individuals 18 and over, teams and organizations, subject to the eligibility rules. One entry per entrant. Read the official rules
Winning builds from Pi Day. Yours could be next.
A starter kit for builders, built in Bolt. Open one, make it yours, and start building Saturday, Oct 17.
